# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_WITH_RSI_BOUNCE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a clean VWAP break, a pullback to VWAP that finds RSI‑oversold bullish candle offers a high‑probability long entry. The pullback provides a better risk‑reward than chasing the initial break, while the RSI‑oversold condition adds a mean‑reversion edge that filters out weak pullbacks.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When price closes above VWAP and the next bar’s low touches VWAP (±0.1% tolerance) while RSI(14) < 30 and the bar is bullish (close > open), enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Stop placed at the prior swing low (most recent HL before entry) or 0.5% below entry, whichever is farther; take profit at 2R or at the next named resistance level, with a runner‑trail of 10% of HWM if price exceeds 1.5R. Regime hint: Works best when VIX is moderate (12‑22) and the market is in an intraday uptrend (price above 200‑period EMA); avoid during strong downtrends or when VIX > 25 (excessive volatility).
